correctness.rationale: Mod-t residue and valuation argument identifies all possible periodic pairs; Hensel coefficient inversion makes the unit-residue core a permutation; affine shear lifting gives powers of two; strictly increasing polynomial-iterate degrees give unbounded dyadic periods. Explicit homogeneous degree-eight jets factor through ub(u+b), forcing F^8 to be identity mod t^9. The witness (1+t,t^2) has eighth iterate differing by t^9 but sixteenth iterate equal at m=10. Exhaustive traversal of 2^20 vertices yields the census and independently a coefficientwise fixed-point enumeration reproduces all counts. These facts are demonstrated in RESULT.md and verified by verify.py.

value.rationale: The 2026 motivating paper explicitly identifies study of longer structure-graph cycles as future research. The finding provides an all-m periodic-core decomposition, a rigorous universal dyadic-period and unboundedness theorem, and a sharp first natural ring cutoff for period 16 together with an exact five-period census and 31488 weak components. This goes beyond routine existence of a two-cycle; the finite count answers a motivated exact invariant at the first 16-cycle cutoff.
